en: The [[annual travel event]] held in Rome [[took]] [[place]] from September 12 to 16 this year.
me: The annual travel event held in Rome
easy: annual travel event held in Rome
요약: 로마 연례 여행 행사가 올해 9월 12~16일에 열렸다.
notes: 문장에는 진짜 동사가 꼭 있어야 한다. taken place(p.p.)만 쓰면 동사 ✕ → took place(take place: 열리다) ○
held in Rome은 event를 꾸미는 말, 진짜 동사는 took
분사구문: Although considered small(작다고 여겨졌지만)에서 행사는 '여겨지는' 쪽이라 p.p. considered

en: However, the other company took a different strategy, dividing the problem into several parts.
me: dividing the problem into several parts.
easy: dividing the problem into several parts
요약: 다른 회사는 문제를 쪼개는 전략을 택했다.
notes: 분사구문: 주어가 직접 ~하면 -ing. 예) (the company) dividing the problem (문제를 나누면서)
다음 문장: make(사역동사) + 목적어 + 동사원형: made each department compete (to compete ✕, competed ✕)
